reason: It is a pretty concept for a guesthouse I have never seen, with no booking numbers behind it. Every agency that has pitched our group has promised more direct bookings and I have never seen the figures.
objection: Nothing here shows that a new site and a WhatsApp bot will move bookings off Booking.com. A design studio can make a lovely demo, and a boat transfer and breakfast bundle is something any hotel could offer without a new brand.
would_change_my_mind: A named hotel of similar size showing its direct booking share before and after, with the figures checked by someone I know.
